title: fix(record-page): Esc in the side preview ends an inline edit and keeps the preview open
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Fixes #36472
Clause-②: no

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRB34k9WUWeGpRnVNm

#36547 merged; main merged at 49024f4a31, both hunks kept

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：在列表右侧的记录预览里点进编辑后按 Esc，只退出编辑、预览留着；再按一次 Esc 才关预览。整页不变。
- 为什么做：记录页专题的子单，预览里按 Esc 会把整个预览连同编辑一起关掉，和整页不一致。
- 出错会怎样：编辑时按 Esc 的结果和整页一样，改了的内容直接放弃、不保存、不提示；不对可以直接撤回这个改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

The card's rulings, verbatim: 「预览里处于编辑状态时，Esc 先退出编辑，预览留着；不在编辑状态时 Esc 才关闭预览。」 and 「编辑里已经改了内容时按 Esc：和整页里的做法保持一致」.

**Changed content + Esc = discard directly (直接放弃), the same as the full page.** On the full page Esc runs the session's `cancel`, which is `InlineEditContext`'s `teardown`: the draft is cleared, nothing is written, no prompt. The preview now does exactly that and stays open.

Mechanism, confirmed in code and by ablation (both halves of the dispatch's hypothesis hold):

1. The drawer's Radix dialog layer hears Esc on the document in the capture phase. At the stack's root it dismisses the whole preview, before the session's window listener ever runs.
2. The session would stand down anyway: its "a layer is open over me" check matched any open `role=dialog`, and the drawer is one.

The fix, one half per component:

- **`NavigationOverlay` (`@object-ui/components`)**: the drawer holds itself open on Esc while it draws an element marked `data-owns-pane-escape` (`escapeOwnedByPaneSession`, beside the existing `data-owns-escape` region rule). Its layer only hears the key when nothing is stacked over it, so a popover or menu over the record still closes first.
- **`InlineEditSaveBar` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`)**: the bar carries that marker while the record is being edited. A dialog that holds the session no longer counts as a layer over it (`escapeOwnedByLayerOver`). Inside a pane, `defaultPrevented` is not read as "someone else handled it", because the pane marks every key it holds itself open on. Whether a layer was over the session is also read when the key is pressed (window capture phase), so a layer that has already closed by the time the key bubbles still owns it. The full-page path is unchanged: no dialog holds the bar, so every check reads as before.

**Scope after #36547 (landed).** This card keeps the whole-record edit session in the preview, whichever path enters it. With #36547 on `main`, the card's original repro path (click a value in the preview) opens that PR's per-field in-place editor, whose Esc belongs to its own Radix layer; it was re-measured in the browser on the merged head (see Verification). The whole-record session can still open in a pane (an authored page's double-click, a page with no record-context writer), and this fix covers it. The two changes do not interfere: the `field` face draws no bar, so it carries no pane marker, and its effect returns before any listener is installed.

The click-to-edit gesture itself is unchanged (「不改「点一下进入编辑」本身的做法。」).

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx`: the keyboard effect (`onKeyDownCapture` / `onKeyDown`), `escapeOwnedByLayerOver`, `paneHolding`.
2. `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`: `handleDrawerEscape` and `escapeOwnedByPaneSession`.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing harness file `InlineEditSaveBar.test.tsx`: "Esc inside the record's side preview (objectstack#36472)". It drives the real `NavigationOverlay` and its Radix sheet. 8 cases: no change (first Esc ends the edit, preview open; second Esc closes it) · changed field (discard, no write, preview open) · the modal preview with no list behind it · a level below the root (Esc ends the edit, does not go back; the next Esc goes back) · a real Radix Popover over the record (Esc closes only the popover) · a layer that closes during the capture phase still owns the key · CONTROL not editing (Esc closes the preview) · full page unchanged (a field that handled the key keeps the session).

No existing test was changed.

## Verification

Two minutes: open the CRM example's Accounts list, hover a name and click its side-panel icon, click the Annual Revenue value, type a number, press Esc. The edit ends, the old value is shown, and the preview stays open. Press Esc again and the preview closes.

**Changed content + Esc in the preview: discarded directly, no prompt (直接放弃), the same as the full page** (full page measured below: Esc with a change keeps the page open, ends the edit, opens no dialog and writes nothing).

<details><summary>Browser, whole-record session in the preview (fix vs origin/main source), CRM example, 1440 wide, Chromium</summary>

Driven with Playwright against this branch's Console (vite, `src`) and a `--fresh` CRM backend. The session was entered through the click-a-value path as it was before #36547. The "before" leg served the two changed files at `origin/main` f3a8a13c14 (working tree only, restored after, blob == HEAD).

| Step | origin/main (before) | this PR (after) |
|---|---|---|
| Account Initech: edit, no change, Esc | preview CLOSED | edit ends, preview open |
| ... Esc again | n/a | preview closes |
| Edit, type 777 into Annual Revenue, Esc | preview CLOSED, input lost | edit ends, preview open, shows 2,500,000.00, stored value unchanged (2500000) |
| Edit, open the Industry select, Esc | select closes, edit stays | select closes, edit and preview stay; next Esc ends the edit, preview stays |
| Full page, type 888, Esc | stays on the page, edit ends, no dialog, nothing written | same (unchanged) |

Lead (CRM example `crm_lead`, Marie Curie, Lead Score / Lead Source), after: Esc ends the edit and the preview stays; the next Esc closes it. With a change: discarded, stored 0, shown 0, preview open. Select open: only the select closes. Full page: same as the account.

One "after" re-run in between was void: vite had not reloaded `navigation-overlay.tsx` after the before-leg restore. I restarted vite, confirmed the served source, and re-ran; the table shows the valid runs.

</details>

<details><summary>Browser, the card's repro on the merged head 49024f4a31 (#36547 on main)</summary>

Click a value in the preview: #36547's per-field editor opens (one floating layer, no save bar). Account Initech / Annual Revenue and lead Marie Curie / Lead Score, each:

- no change, Esc: the editor closes, the preview stays open; Esc again: the preview closes;
- type 777, Esc: the editor closes, nothing written (stored 2500000 / 0 unchanged), the old value shown, the preview stays open.

</details>

**HotCRM 「线索」 preview: NOT MEASURED.** The HotCRM repository is not in this container. The CRM example's lead object was measured in its place, above.

- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 38 derived, 38 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 172 passed, 2 skipped. An earlier attempt at that one was killed by the OOM killer while the browser stack shared the box; it was re-run.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (head 264d9cbe0c, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed, src is vitest-aliased)</summary>

Drawer hold removed: 6 failed, 13 passed. The holding dialog counted as a layer: 5 failed. `defaultPrevented` trusted in a pane: 5 failed. No press-time read: 1 failed (the capture-phase case). Every leg restored blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. The first try of the drawer leg was a no-op the tool refused (its replacement text was already in the file); it was redone with a distinct marker.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- With no edit session at the drawer's root, Esc pressed inside a plain text field closes the preview (the drawer applies its field-owns-Esc rule only below the root). The card says Esc closes the preview when not editing; this is noted, not filed.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` #2: no `content/docs/frontend/` page describes the drawer's Esc, so there is no docs page to update.
